martha.name: Martha
martha.comment: Martha, surprisingly it's a great day for swimming, with ideal temps from 10:00 to 12:00. Not so much for running, but who needs that when you can hit the water? The sun will be out and it'll be a warm 23°C, perfect for a relaxing swim.

britt.name: Britt
britt.comment: Britt, Saturday's looking great for a swim, especially between 10:00 and 12:00 when it's nice and warm. The temperatures are perfect, ranging from 21°C to 28°C, making it ideal for a dip. Not the best day for running, but who needs that when you can cool off in the water? Maybe surprise Martha with a swim when she's free.
